title: New quickstart visuals: canary, A/B, and resilient fallback policy screens
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a set of onboarding/quickstart visuals and product screenshots for the Rollouts feature. Scope: 1) Canary rollout flow (setup, traffic slider, metric preview), 2) A/B test setup (variant naming, traffic split, metric selection), 3) Fallback policy editor (automated fallback rules, fallback model selection, alerting). Create Figma frames, export PNG/JPG screenshots for docs, and craft short caption copy for the quickstart guide.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma frames for Canary, A/B, and Fallback screens ready for handoff
Exported 3x PNGs per screen (desktop wide, centered modal, mobile preview) uploaded to Drive
Quickstart doc snippets (300-500 characters each) with captions for each screenshot included
Design reviewed and signed off by PM and Engineering with actionable notes addressed
Accessible color contrast and component spacing verified against Redwood design tokens
design_files: Figma frame IDs: Canary_desktop_1400, AB_flow_1428, Fallback_editor_1456
